_comment: Clock-gating and logic-depth units for MI's MIU RTL (tools/check-cg.py, tools/check-ngd.py; docs/rtl-coding-style.md, 'Local clock gating' and 'Logic depth'; the partition is MA's Phase 2, MIU tab rev 147). Each bench is the module's value-model bench (test/miu/*_tb.cpp) in its --cg mode, built by test/miu/cg-build.sh at the unit's parameters: idle is reset and then no work, medium work on about a third of the cycles, high work nearly every cycle. miu_cap is one address slot's ccv_rcu_miu_addr capture at its one size.
